summary: Senior backend engineer with 6+ years building production multi-tenant SaaS, healthcare, and data platforms across enterprise, fintech, and cybersecurity. Designs scalable, fault-tolerant distributed services in Python (Django, DRF, FastAPI) and Go, integrating Generative AI APIs (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Claude) and LangChain RAG pipelines into production as containerized, CI/CD-enabled services.
technicalSummary: Strong in relational and NoSQL data modeling (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Cosmos DB, Elasticsearch, Redis), with pipelines processing 5M+ records, ~30% faster API responses, and a platform serving 3,000+ concurrent daily users at 99.9% availability. Experienced in secure system design (RBAC/IAM, MFA, envelope encryption, audit logging) and LLM workflows including RAG and speech-to-structured-data pipelines. Currently building AEGIS, a healthcare platform with secure patient records and AI-assisted clinical documentation.
